tei:div.tei:p: 277) ༄༅/ gtor ma'i lhan thabs kyi rigs nye bar 'kho ba 'ga' zhig bzhugs so/ 278)dpal ldan bla ma thugs rje'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ chu gtor gyi las rim gzhan rnams gong du bstan nas/ 'dir nye bar 'kho ba'i cha lag 'ga' zhig ston te/ de yang sngon dus/ bka' gdams rin po che'i skyes chen rnams kyis phyag bzhes su mdzad pa'i dkar chag bzhi'am cha lngar grags pa'i rim pa rnams gtong bar spro na/ gtor snod rnams su ril bu bdun bdun re'i 'bru 'bras sogs ci rigs chu dang bcas pa bshams pa'i dang po de la/bsangs sbyang byin rlabs rnams 'dzam ser gyi skabs nas byung ba ltar/ 'bru gsum gyi byin rlabs yan chad grub rjes/ bdag nyid 'phags pa'i thugs ka'i hriḥyig las// 'od 'phros rje btsun mi g.yo sku mdog ljang*// ral gri zhags pa 'dzin pa spyan drangs nas// mdun du pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur// om̐ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces sngags lan bdun dang*/ ārya a tsa la sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ badzra arghaṃ/ puṣpe/ sogs kyis mchod cing chu sbreng la/ mchod gtor bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di 'bul zhing*// mgon po khyod la gus pas bstod lags na// nyon mongs bdud bzhi'i dpung las rnam rgyal zhing*// mchog thun dngos grub deng 'dir stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol zhing rang 280)gnas su gshegs par bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ slar yang bdag nyid thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// rje btsun 'phags ma sngo ljang rab tu mdzes// mchog spyin atpal bsnams pa spyan drangs nas// mdun du pad zlar dgyes par bzhugs par gyur// mchod gtor byin gyis brlabs pa 'bul bar bsam la chu sbreng zhing*/ na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi satwā naṃ/ ho ho bha ga wa ti ma hā satwa sarba buddha a wa lo ki te/ mā bi laṃ ba/ mā bi laṃ ba/ i daṃ ba lingta gṛ hṇa pa ya/

gṛ hṇa pa ya/ sarba bi pañtsa re swā hā/ arghaṃ/ puṣpe= bdag gis gus pas phul ba'i mchod gtor 'di// bzhes nas bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can kun// ngan song 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa chen po las// sgrol mdzad 'phags ma khyed kyis skyabs du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab cing lha gshegs par mos la/ klu gtor la yang*/ byin rlabs sogs gong ma rnams ltar las/ khyad par 'bru gsum gyis mjug tu/ aum̐ ā ka ro 281) mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ/ ā dya nutpanna twātā/ om̐ ā hūm̐ phaṭa swā hāḥ zhes pas kyang byin gyis brlab la/ klu rigs rnams spyan drangs pa ni/ om̐ ba ta li/ ba ta li/ ma hā ba ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dza dza swā hā/ sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar chos thos pa'i// rgyal rigs bram ze rje dang dmangs rigs gdol// so so'i g.yog 'khor dpag med tshogs dang bcas// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir myur du gshegs su gsol// om̐ ā gatstsha ma hā na ga a dhi pa ta ye/ gṛ hṇe daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bhu rbhu wa phruṃ khruṃ swā hā/ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ zhes pas spyan drangs shing bzhugs gsol la/ chu sbreng zhing*/ om̐ na ga a dhi pa ta ye/ gṛ hṇe daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ arghaṃ/ puṣpe= om̐ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phruṃ phruḥswā hā/ om̐ bhakaṣa ya/ bhakaṣa ya/ sa ma ya tiṣtha dzuṃ phruṃ swā hā/ ces pa rnams kyi se gol bcas pas chu sbyin/ mthar chos kyi 282) sbyin pa yang bya zhing*/ 'dod don gsol ba ni/ klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// gtsang sbyar mchod sbyin mchog 'dis tshim byos la// ru nga phrag dog gnod 'tshe gtan spangs shing*// char chu dus 'bebs rgyal khams bde bar mdzod// zhes brjod la/ om̐ nā ga a dhi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra gatstsha/ om̐ ga ru ḍa/ haṃ sa he/ tsa le tsa le swā hā/ zhes pas rang gnas su bskrad do/ su rū pa ni/ byin rlabs gzhan rnams ltar dang*/ ā kā ro sogs kyis kyang byin rlabs la/

rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rin chen gzugs mdzes kyi// byams pa'i thugs rjes yi dwags kun skyabs shing*/ 'dod yon bza' btung longs spyod phun tshogs pas// ci 'dod re ba bskangs shing tshim par gyur// na maḥ su rū pa ya ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te/ saṃ myaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ om̐ su ru su ru/ pra su ru/ ta ra ta ra bha ra bha ra/ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra/ sma ra sma ra/ santa ra 283) sa ya/ santa ra sa ya/ sarba pre ta nāṃ swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gsum sogs brjod pas se gol dang bcas te chu sbyin shing*/ a pa sa rantu/ a wa tā ra pre kaṣi ṇe/ da da mya naṃ/ sarba lo kā dhā tu bhā si nāṃ/ pre ta nā ma hā ṭaṃ/ 'phags mchog rin chen gzugs mdzes thugs rje dang*/ sngags dang ting 'dzin bden pa'i gzi byin gyis// gnas ngan yi dwags 'gro ba'i rigs gyur kun// bde ldan bla med byang chub thob gyur cig de dag gi dkar cha bzhi'i rim pa bzhi'i grub nas/ cha lnga pa ltar na gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams la bsngo ba yin kyang*/ de ni gong gi brgya rtsa'i 'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par bod khams kyi zhes sogs 'byung ba de kas thus phyir/ 'dir cha bzhi pa kho nar byas pa'o/ dkar cha bzhi 'di dag ni brgya rtsa'i snga phyi gang du sbyar yang rung mod kyang*/ deng sang phal che ba'i stag len du 'di dag sngon la grub rjes/ de nas tshe 'das sogs la dmigs na bar do chabazhi dang*/ de nas 'byung bzhi'am gsum sogs gang 'os skabs dang sbyor/ mdzad pa nyid kho na mang ngo*/ de la bar do cha bzhi'i brgya rtsa'i nang du thus pa zhig yod med kyang*/ gshin po'i ches du rgyas par spro na/ gtor snod bzhir ril bu bdun nam nyer gcig sogs gang 'byor chu dang bcas pa bshams la/ bsangs sbyang byin rlabs spyi ltar dang*/ sambha ra'i gzungs ci mang brjod cing*/ cha dang po ni/ arghaṃ sogs kyi mchod la/ brtse ldan phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus dang*// skyabs gnas bla ma yi dam lha tshogs rnams// mchod gtor 'di bzhes bar do'i sems can la// thugs rje chen pos rjes su bzung gsol//

gnyis pa byin rlabs mchod sogs gong ltar las/ ye shes las grub gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dang*// dam can rgya mtsho bka' srung tshogs bcas kyang*// thugs dam skongs nas nyam thag sems can gyi// skyabs mgon dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol// gsum pa byin rlabs sngar bzhin las/ bde bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan bsgrag cing*/ tshe 'das rnams la gnod cing 'tsho byed cing*// lan chags shi gshed bgegs rigs thams cad kyang*// mchod sbyin 'di yis mgu 285) tshim gyis la// thar pa'i lam gyi gegs dang 'tshe ba spong*// bzhi pa yang mtshan sogs gong ltar dang*/ snga lus bor nas phyi lus dam blangs pa'i// bar do'i 'gro kun sbyin pa 'dis tshim zhing*// 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag sdug bsngal kun bral nas// dag pa'i zhing du brdzus te skye bar shog rgyas par spro na mi 'khrug pa'i chu sbyin yang 'dir bya zhing*/ sangs rgyas sems can bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// ces sogs kyi bsngo zhing smon lam ci rigs kyang gdab par bya'o/ ༈ rje btsun dam pa rgya gar ba'i lugs kyi 'byung bzhi mtshon byed kyi gtor ma zla gam/ gru gsum/ zlum po/ gru bzhi rnams dang*/ ngar glud 'chang bu dang bcas pa bshams la/ badzra a mṛ ta sogs nas swa bha'i mthar/ rin chen snod du ye shes bdud rtsi yi// ngo bo nyid la rnam pa 'byung bzhi'i tshul// dbang po drug gi spyaud yul phun tshogs pa'i// 'dod yon phung po nam mkha' mnyam par gyur// yaṃ/ raṃ/ waṃ/ laṃ/ om̐ 286) āḥhūm̐/ bdag nyid rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas sku// smug nag ḍa ma ru dang dril bu 'khrol// snang srid thams cad rten 'brel sgyu mar shar// byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar ba gcig tu gyur// yam̐/ i ī/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ lan bdun nam nyer gcig bzla zhing*/ arghaṃ/ puṣpe/ sogs brjod pas chu sbreng*/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpal ldan bla ma mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rigs// sprul 'khor bcas pa rlung rdzas mchod pa'i sprin//

phul bas nga rgyal tshad nad gshin rje'i gdon// zhi zhing tshe dpal longs spyod rgyas par mdzod// wam̐/ u u/ pa pha ba bha ma/ bdun bzlas mchod pa mchod cing*/ dpal ldan bla ma chags med padma'i 287)rigs// sprul 'khor bcas la chu rdzas mchod pa'i sprin// phul bas 'dod chags grang nad klu gdon tshogs// zhi zhing snang srid dbang du 'du bar mdzod// lam̐/ l̥ l̥̄/ ta tha da dha na/ bdun dang*/ mchod cing*/ dpal ldan bla ma thogs med las kyi rigs// sprul 'khor bcas la sa rdzas mchod pa'i sprin// phul bas phrag dog pad kan 'gong po'i gdon// zhi zhing gnod cing rdul du rlag par mdzod// de nas ngar glud la 'bru gsum dang*/ sambhā ra'i sngags dang*/ a kā ros byin gyis brlab cing*/ de bzhin bshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod la/ 'dod yon lnga ldan glud gtor bzang po 'di// 'byung ba sa chu me rlung brag dang shing*// nam mkha' la brten lha srin 'byung po'i rigs// snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre'i tshogs la bsngo*/ sha khrag drod dbugs rtsa rgyus spags pa dang*/ lus ngag yid kun glud du 'di khyer la// bu lon lan chags gnod 'tshe kun 288) bral nas// rang gzhan bde legs lam la 'khod gyur cig dkon mchog bla ma'i byin rlabs nus stobs dang*// bdag gi lhag bsam mchod sbyin dge 'bras mthus// 'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun rkyen phun tshogs 'grub// bde legs yid bzhin 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog gzhan yang bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs kyang rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la bya'o/ de ltar chu gtor gyi nye bar 'kho ba 'ga' tsam mdor bsdus nas bkod pa yin zhing*/ 'dir ma 'thus la/ sbrul gtor rtsa sngags dang dbang phyug gu drug cu pa/ klu gtor ba su nye/ mi g.yo drug cu sogs ni so so'i gzhung rnams las shes par bya zhing*/ cha gsum sogs kyang bka'agasar rnying mtha' dag mthun par 'dug tshe 'dir dgos su ma bris so/
'di bkod dge bas 'gro ba rnams dge legs kyi lam la 'khod par gyur cig shubhaṃ/
